title: Solid Power
summary: Louisville, Colorado producer of sulfide solid electrolytes for solid-state batteries.
bodyHtml:
Solid Power makes the solid electrolyte powder that replaces liquid electrolyte in solid-state cells, and has worked with BMW and Ford on cell development.

Its strategy is to sell electrolyte material and licence cell designs to established battery makers rather than compete as a cell manufacturer.

Why it matters

  • Sulfide solid electrolyte
  • Licensing model
  • Automotive partnerships

businessMeaning: Materials suppliers can win even when cell makers fragment. The risk is that sulfide electrolytes remain difficult to handle at scale.
investmentLens: A listed small-cap materials play; revenue depends on partners reaching production, not on laboratory results.
